title: Peekremote (v2): Add Data rate computation
description:
1. Populate bandwidth, mcs, number of streams and guard interval in the
   phy_info for 11n, 11ac, 11ax respectively.
   (support for 11be phy_info is yet to be defined in ieee80211 dissector)
2. Conditionally display the actual Guard Interval value in uS, based on phy_type.
3. Add a new field in ExtFlags to indicate Quarter Guard interval for 11ax and 11be frames.

Closes: #19815

@kripa-v can you look this warning :

```
Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-peekremote.c hf_peekremote_extflags_half_gi_11ax11be : - filter "peekremote.extflags.half_gi" appears 1 items before - labels are "Half Guard Interval (0.4us)" and "Half Guard Interval (1.6us)"
Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-peekremote.c hf_peekremote_extflags_full_gi_11ax11be : - filter "peekremote.extflags.full_gi" appears 1 items before - labels are "Full Guard Interval (0.8us)" and "Full Guard Interval (3.2us)"
```

Hi @alagoutte, 
Thank you for reviewing the MR.
This overriding of field was intentionally introduced, as the durations of 'Half Guard Interval' and 'Full Guard Interval' depends on the phy type.

|GI |11n/11ac | 11ax/11be |
| ------ |------ | ------ |
| Full GI |  0.8uS     |  3.2uS      |
| Half GI       |  0.4 uS     |  1.6uS      |
| Quarter GI       |   -    |    0.8 uS    |

This allows us to display the correct duration based on the type, as shown in the screenshot.

Is there a better approach to conditionally determine the representation of a field's (bit's) meaning in relation to the value of another field? 
Please advise.

![Screenshot_2024-05-03_at_1.32.16_AM](/uploads/024d0ed88c7cc011270a13468848fb6d/Screenshot_2024-05-03_at_1.32.16_AM.png)

You need to use different display filter

or you can use append_item
or you can add generated item with the value of Guard Interval

Thanks for suggesting these altenatives.
Used the append_item option, and removed redundant definitions.
